name: SparkPoint Fremont VITA
description: Free current year and back tax preparation for low-to-moderate income families in Fremont, Newark, and Union City
fullDescription: SparkPoint Fremont at the Fremont Family Resource Center offers free tax preparation for current year and back taxes for low to moderate income families.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free current year tax preparation (February-April)
- Free back tax preparation (year-round)
- Federal and state returns
- Help with tax credits
- IRS-certified preparers
howToGetIt:
1. For current year taxes, book an in-person appointment online (call 510-298-1796 for scheduling help)
2. For back taxes, call 510-574-2026 to request an appointment
3. Gather required tax documents using the checklist on the City of Fremont website
4. Attend your appointment at the Fremont Family Resource Center
5. Review and sign your return
keywords: SparkPoint, Fremont, VITA, free tax preparation, back taxes, Family Resource Center, low income, tax credits, Fremont Family
